SELECT strftime(date, '%a') AS weekday, SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY weekday
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT channel, device, SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY channel, device
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT device, date_trunc('week', date) AS week, SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(orders), 0) AS average_order_value
FROM daily_channel_device
WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-25' AND DATE '2026-10-22'
GROUP BY device, week
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC
LIMIT 1000

WITH spend AS (
  SELECT channel,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-22' THEN ad_spend END) AS this_period,
    SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-22' THEN ad_spend END) AS last_period
  FROM daily_channel_device
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel, this_period / NULLIF(last_period, 0) - 1 AS growth
FROM spend
WHERE last_period > 0
ORDER BY growth DESC
LIMIT 1000
